Map: PGE2 - PTGER2 - Gsα, Gs cycle and adenylate cyclase (mirror)
Why: EP2 raises cAMP and sensitises nociceptors and dorsal horn neurons
Note: Spinal EP2 is needed for inflammatory hyperalgesia; in TMJ OA, EP2 on satellite glia drives pain. In sensory neurons EP3C and EP4 carry most of the cAMP response (Southall 2001).
References: Reinold H et al. Spinal inflammatory hyperalgesia is mediated by prostaglandin E receptors of the EP2 subtype. J Clin Invest 115(3):673-9. 2005. doi: 10.1172/JCI23618.
